verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Vercel's own official MCP server (mcp.vercel.com), which serves Vercel's tools to external AI clients. That is the server role and does not show Vercel consuming third-party MCP servers. Nothing in the pack shows Vercel Agent, eve, or any other Vercel surface letting a user register external MCP servers and use their tools. The axis still applies because Vercel ships its own AI assistant and agent framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
